title: Harmony reports a loss-of-life incident at its Mponeng mine
summary: The post Harmony reports a loss-of-life incident at its Mponeng mine appeared first on Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited .
body_markdown:
**Johannesburg. Monday, 16 November 2026.** Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited (“Harmony” and/or “the Company”) deeply regrets to report a loss-of-life incident at its Mponeng mine in the West Rand of Gauteng on Saturday, 14 November 2026.


A locomotive operator was injured while conducting tramming activities in the Carbon Leader Reef development section of the mine. A formal investigation to determine the circumstances surrounding this incident is underway. The Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources and other relevant stakeholders have been notified.


Harmony expresses its deepest sympathies to the employee’s family, friends and colleagues, and is providing support to all those affected.


Safety remains Harmony’s foremost priority. We are strengthening critical controls, enhancing training and development, and embedding lessons learnt from incidents. We are also working in partnership with our stakeholders towards our goal of zero harm and safer workplaces for all.


Ends.
